title: CPython: twenty re-entrancy use-after-frees, all of them inside pymalloc

pymalloc-repros.title: Consumer-side temporal defects in CPython whose memory comes from pymalloc
pymalloc-repros.note: The inventory states this is the whole reachable set at the pin, not a sample.

cheribsd.not_run: no stock-CheriBSD reading exists. This corpus's CheriBSD arms are the poisoncap-* pair, which is our own adapter for a competitor's platform and which arms.json excludes on purpose; plain purecap has never been run. ports/cpython/pymalloc has a cheribsd branch, so it is buildable.

capstone-sublet.because: the run brackets each case twice: mode 0 is the same adapter with no revoke at the nested allocator's release, mode 1 is the Sublet discipline. Mode 1 is this arm, so the cell reads the m1 row; the m0 row is the baseline that makes the pair a single-variable comparison. This replaces the 2026-09-19 freestanding reading: the same adapter now runs in a Capstone process with full musl libc, so the cell is PAIRED with the one to its left instead of being measured on another vehicle.
